corrections.before:
**Where it is.** The verifier, the modules it imports and the builder of this delivery are in
`verification/delivery_scripts/`. Copy that folder to a new folder of your own, outside the delivery, and run it
from there, so that Python's cache files are not written into the delivery. Use an empty work folder on a short path.
On Windows, use a Python with tzdata.

```bash
S=<your copy of verification/delivery_scripts>
V="uv run --no-project --with tzdata python $S/verify_walmart_152_delivery.py"
D=<path of the delivery folder>; W=C:/w152            # a new, empty work folder
$V $D $W data --earlier=<folder holding the earlier deliveries> --task-start=2026-10-31T17:27:41Z
$V $D $W source.extract
$V $D $W oxylabs.paths                                 # and so on, one step at a time
$V $D $W probe.extract
$V $D $W report --report=$W/PACKAGE_VERIFICATION.txt
```
corrections.after:
**It is not published here.** The verifier, the modules it imports and the builder of the delivery were in the
delivery's `verification/delivery_scripts/`. They are bound to the delivery folder's layout, to the preparation
workstation's paths and to private inputs, so this repository does not publish them ([`manifests/EXCLUDED.csv`](../manifests/EXCLUDED.csv)
gives each one's SHA-256). Their record is published: [`evidence/verification/`](../evidence/verification/) holds the report, each
step's command, exit code and duration (`steps.jsonl`), each step's log, the JUnit XML and the data checks. What follows
says how the verifier worked, to read that record. For this repository, the checks of section 1 take its place.
